$comment: Frozen inputs of the 0.20.0 ledger (hds#447, hds#450), read by scripts/upgrade/build-ledger.mjs. 0.20.0 shipped before ledgers existed, so its record was written after the fact. removed.json and renames.json are codemods/removed-0.20.json and the RENAMES map of codemods/hds-prefix.mjs exactly as the 0.20.0 tarball published them; the live files keep serving the codemods and may change, these copies may not. Each CHANGELOG.md:<line> is numbered as the file read when 0.20.0 shipped (its section starts on line 3), and its needle is the text that finds the line.
summary: Pattern components move to /patterns; deprecated, lab and folded components, Hds* aliases and 7 runtime deps are removed.

moved.plain: {name} is no longer exported from the package root; import it from {to} instead.

renamed.plain: {name} is removed from the package root; use {to}, the same component under its bare name.

removed.plain: {name} is removed with no drop-in replacement, so rewrite or delete the code that imports it.
removed.privatePlain: {name} is no longer exported, so style its component through the component's props instead.

steps.subject: Button-pressed
steps.plain: A pressed Button now tints only its fill with a 5% overlay, white in dark mode, instead of dimming the whole control, and the press no longer animates.

steps.subject: Box-sx-scale-names
steps.plain: Box sx spacing given as a t-shirt name such as 'md' now applies that spacing, where before it applied none.

steps.subject: Input-prefix-slot
steps.plain: A string passed to Input's prefix prop now shows as text inside the field, where before it went to the input element as an attribute.
steps.needle: `Input` takes the native date and time types

steps.subject: Tooltip-shadow
steps.plain: Tooltip now casts the floating shadow that popovers and menus use instead of the dialog shadow.

steps.subject: AssetImg-expand-label
steps.plain: AssetImg's expand label now uses the on-accent text color, so it stays readable in dark mode.

steps.subject: Table-sort-hover
steps.plain: A sortable Table header now fades its label to the muted color on hover.
steps.needle: `Table`'s sortable header button now has hover feedback

steps.subject: Input-padding
steps.plain: Input keeps its inner padding beside icons, the clear button and the spinner, so long text no longer runs under them.

steps.subject: Card-selectable-keys
steps.plain: Card selectable, which replaces SelectableCard, toggles on click or Space only, so code or tests that press Enter to toggle it must press Space instead.

steps.subject: Button-iconOnly-label
steps.plain: An icon-only Button now takes its accessible name from label, unless it has an aria-label.

steps.subject: Select-Combobox-overlay-names
steps.plain: The open Select list and the Combobox popup now carry an accessible name, so tests that find them by role and name may need the new name.

steps.subject: Select-Combobox-accessible-names
steps.plain: Combobox options now report their real position, and a Select with showLabel={false} is named by its label and value, so tests that find them by role and name may need updating.

steps.subject: pattern-rows-Stack
steps.plain: The rows inside PageHeader, FormActions, DataTableSection and DestructiveSection now carry data-hds-component="Stack" instead of "Cluster", so selectors and tests that look for Cluster there must change.

steps.subject: manifest-health
steps.plain: The manifest no longer has a health field, so manifest.health is now undefined.

steps.subject: StatusDot
steps.plain: StatusDot still works but is removed in 0.21.0; use Badge dot with the same tone, size and label, and move any style prop to a wrapper or a className first.

steps.subject: StatusDotProps
steps.plain: StatusDotProps is removed in 0.21.0; use BadgeProps instead.

steps.subject: hds.density
steps.plain: hds.density still works but is deprecated; use hds.semantic.space.scale one step down, so density.sm becomes scale.xs.

steps.subject: Box-sx-layout-names
steps.plain: Box sx spacing names 'tight', 'normal', 'inset' and 'spacious' still work but are deprecated, and a development build warns once for each; use 'sm' to 'xl' instead.

steps.subject: Stack-gap-layout-names
steps.plain: Stack gap names 'tight', 'normal', 'inset' and 'spacious' still work and do not warn yet, but are removed in 1.0.0, and Stack names no replacement until then.
steps.needle: Stack's same four names still read the scale steps

steps.subject: kept-utilities
steps.plain: Sixteen Tailwind utilities that only HDS's deleted internal files used, such as pt-1 and max-w-2xl, still ship in styles.css and tokens.css until 1.0.0, so a page that relies on HDS's compiled CSS for them should generate them with its own Tailwind.
